/* saleson.shop.log.PrivacyAccessLogHistMapper.getPrivacyAccessLogHistListByParam */ SELECT A.HIST_ID , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT , (CASE WHEN A.LOGIN_TYPE = 'MANAGER' THEN (SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM OP_MANAGER WHERE A.MANAGER_ID = USER_ID) WHEN A.LOGIN_TYPE = 'SELLER' THEN (SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM OP_SELLER WHERE A.MANAGER_ID = SELLER_ID) ELSE '' END) AS LOGIN_ID , A.PRIVACY_ACCESS_LOG_ID , A.REASON , (SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'EXCELDOWNLOAD_REASON_TYPE' AND A.REASON_TYPE = ID) AS REASON_TYPE FROM ( SELECT OP.HIST_ID , OP.CREATED_AT , OP.MANAGER_ID , (SELECT LOGIN_TYPE FROM OP_PRIVACY_ACCESS_LOG WHERE OP.PRIVACY_ACCESS_LOG_ID = ID) AS LOGIN_TYPE , OP.PRIVACY_ACCESS_LOG_ID , OP.REASON , OP.REASON_TYPE FROM OP_PRIVACY_ACCESS_LOG_HIST OP WHERE OP.PRIVACY_ACCESS_LOG_ID = #{id} ORDER BY OP.CREATED_AT DESC ) A
